items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Then I went with Alonzo Ross's band... So we left Eagle Eye and went with Alonzo Ross.

ctx.x: Yeah. Then I stayed with the band, with Eagle Eye, for quite awhile. I don't know exactly how many years. Then I went with Alonzo Ross's band. He was from Florida, too.
